rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water-supply fault and ordered checks sensibly (tap, hose kink, then inlet mesh filter), matching the ground-truth first step and hidden cause. It gave appropriate safety guidance ('switch off and unplug the machine, turn off the tap... have a towel ready') and reserved engineer escalation for a persistent 4C with clean filter and good supply. No facts were invented, no parts recommended, and the problem was resolved in three turns; the only minor nit is the image card describing the mesh at the 'tap/valve end' while the text says the machine end, a small inconsistency that did not mislead the customer.
